value: Someone has eaten a delicious donut.\nThe other is enraged... What to do?
A donut made of snow is offered.\nIt only serves to add fuel to the fire...
Will a blizzard cool the anger? Maybe\nusing the donut-eater as a shield will.
A rabbit hops by, which soothes them!\nThe promise of a donut brings peace.
$aFoes grant 5x SP for the next $a0,\nand then 2x SP thereafter! (Only highest\nvalue applied. Does not stack.)
